value: **Involvement**: Teachers partnered with researchers in an iterative collaborative design process to conceptualize, author, and contextualize curricular materials and learning activities tailored to their classroom environments. **Evidence**: "Through a design-based research process, engaging students a nd our partner teacher as co-designers, we discovered activities and equipment that are not only interesting and engaging to students, but also fit within constraints of a high school curriculum."
